subject: Provisioning walkthrough and admin lifecycle
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@olivetech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Provisioning walkthrough and admin lifecycle

Sara —

Thanks again for signing with Redwood. To make the initial tenant setup smooth, here’s the minimal plan I propose and the items we’ll need from your side before the kickoff:

1) Admin roster and primary contact
   - Primary admin (name + email) who can approve project creation and API key policy.
2) Desired workspace/project name
   - We typically create a single `project` per environment (e.g., olivetech-prod).
3) API key strategy
   - Short-lived service token vs. long-lived API key? If you want rotation automated we can wire a service account pattern.
4) KMS / key wrapping requirements
   - If you have a customer-managed key, share the KMS ARN and an admin contact.
5) SSO / SCIM intent
   - If you plan to use SSO we’ll coordinate the SAML metadata after initial provisioning.

Proposed deliverables from Redwood during the first sprint (2 business days):
- Create workspace `olivetech-prod`
- Seed admin user(s) and one service account for CI
- Provide an initial API key and instructions for rotation
- Upload provisioning checklist to a shared Drive (link below)

I’ve attached the provisioning checklist to this thread. If Jamal is your infrastructure lead, please confirm and I’ll route the tasks accordingly.

Available for a quick 30-minute walkthrough today or tomorrow — what works best?

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Onboarding
Redwood Inference
attachments: provisioning-checklist.xlsx

From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@olivetech.com>

Subject: Re: Provisioning walkthrough and admin lifecycle

Thanks, Aditya.

Quick answers:
- Primary admin: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@olivetech.com> (security lead)
- Workspace: "olivetech-prod" is perfect
- API key strategy: prefer a service-account pattern with automated rotation; we'd like a 30-day rotation cadence if possible
- KMS: we will be using AWS KMS with a customer-managed key — I’ll share the ARN and our security contact in a separate email by EOD.
- SSO: yes, we plan to use SAML SSO but want to get initial tenants and keys in place first.

I attached our security contacts PDF that lists the owners for compliance.

Available for a walkthrough tomorrow (Thu) between 10–12 PT.

—Sara
Director of Infrastructure, OliveTech
attachments: OliveTech-Security-Contacts.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:23:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning walkthrough and admin lifecycle

Aditya / Karthik —

Couple of operational notes before the call with Sara + Jamal: 

- Role mapping
  - I recommend the following baseline roles in `olivetech-prod`: Admin (Jamal), Billing-Owner (Sara), Developer, ServiceAccount (CI). That keeps entitlements minimal for PCI/PHI-sensitive flows.
- Service account pattern
  - We'll create a service account with a rotating short-lived token (Redwood-managed rotation). We'll seed one long-lived API key as a fallback only if Jamal requests it.
- KMS onboarding
  - If they bring a CMK we need the ARN and an IAM principal to add to the key policy (we'll supply a template).
- Project scaffolding
  - Create initial project `olivetech-prod/default` and a `sandbox` project (read-only) for engineering.

Action items for the 15-minute pre-call: 
- Aditya: confirm you’ll ask Jamal to accept the Admin invite during the walkthrough
- Karthik: prepare the role mapping snippet and the KMS policy template
- Monica: I’ll draft the onboarding checklist updates for SSO + CMK flow

On the call we should confirm rotation cadence (they asked 30 days) and whether they want ephemeral tokens via our service account or a delegated key exchange.

—Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Sara / Jamal —

Great — let’s lock in Thu 10:30 AM PT for the 30-minute provisioning walkthrough (I sent a calendar invite). Agenda: quick intros, confirm Admin invite, create `olivetech-prod` + seed a service account, review KMS next steps, and verify rotation cadence and SSO timeline.

Pre-call checklist for OliveTech (please have these ready):
- Jamal on the call and able to accept admin invite
- KMS ARN or ownership contact (if CMK)
- Confirmation that 30-day rotation cadence is acceptable

Post-call deliverables (Redwood):
- Workspace and project created, admin invite sent
- Service account created with integrated short-lived token + rotation docs
- KMS policy template sent to Jamal for review
- HubSpot record updated: HS-57321 (I’ll attach the provisioning checklist to the record)

Link to provisioning guide: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-provisioning-guide

If anything changes to the time, let me know. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
